  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Mints a random token for `GET /api/admin/export?downloadToken=`, so a
browser can download the export by plain navigation (streaming it to
disk) without an Authorization header. Valid for 60 seconds, single
use, bound to the calling admin; login sessions only, not API tokens.
